    # Define beam dimensions (increased width for structural robustness)
    beam_w = 0.3  # width (max 0.6 m)
    beam_h = 0.2  # height (max 1.5 m)
    density = 500.0  # default density

    # Left strip (x=12.4-12.6)
    left_beams = []
    # First band (0.5-2.5): 3 beams at y=0.6, 1.6, 2.4
    for y in [0.6, 1.6, 2.4]:
        b = sandbox.add_beam(x=12.5, y=y, width=beam_w, height=beam_h, density=density)
        sandbox.set_material_properties(b, restitution=0.05)
        left_beams.append(b)
    # Second band (2.5-5): 3 beams at y=2.6, 3.6, 4.6
    for y in [2.6, 3.6, 4.6]:
        b = sandbox.add_beam(x=12.5, y=y, width=beam_w, height=beam_h, density=density)
        sandbox.set_material_properties(b, restitution=0.05)
        left_beams.append(b)
    # Third band (5-7.5): 3 beams at y=5.6, 6.6, 7.4
    for y in [5.6, 6.6, 7.4]:
        b = sandbox.add_beam(x=12.5, y=y, width=beam_w, height=beam_h, density=density)
        sandbox.set_material_properties(b, restitution=0.05)
        left_beams.append(b)

    # Middle strip (x=13.0) has one beam in the second band (y=3.6)
    middle_beam = sandbox.add_beam(x=13.0, y=3.6, width=beam_w, height=beam_h, density=density)
    sandbox.set_material_properties(middle_beam, restitution=0.05)

    # Right strip (x=13.4-13.6) has two beams in the third band (y=5.6, 6.6)
    right_beams = []
    for y in [5.6, 6.6]:
        b = sandbox.add_beam(x=13.5, y=y, width=beam_w, height=beam_h, density=density)
        sandbox.set_material_properties(b, restitution=0.05)
        right_beams.append(b)

    # Add joints
    # Connect left beams vertically
    for i in range(1, len(left_beams)):
        y_anchor = (left_beams[i].position.y + left_beams[i-1].position.y) / 2
        sandbox.add_joint(left_beams[i], left_beams[i-1], (12.5, y_anchor), type='rigid')

    # Connect middle beam to left beams
    # Middle beam is at y=3.6, which is in the second band. Connect to the left beam at y=3.6 (index 4)
    y_anchor = (middle_beam.position.y + left_beams[4].position.y) / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(middle_beam, left_beams[4], (13.0, y_anchor), type='rigid')

    # Connect right beams to left beams in the third band
    # Right beams are at y=5.6 and 6.6, connect to left beams at y=5.6 and 6.6
    for i in range(len(right_beams)):
        y_anchor = (right_beams[i].position.y + left_beams[6 + i].position.y) / 2
        sandbox.add_joint(right_beams[i], left_beams[6 + i], (13.5, y_anchor), type='rigid')

    # Connect right beams vertically
    for i in range(1, len(right_beams)):
        y_anchor = (right_beams[i].position.y + right_beams[i-1].position.y) / 2
        sandbox.add_joint(right_beams[i], right_beams[i-1], (13.5, y_anchor), type='rigid')

    # Connect left beams to right beams
    # Connect left beam at y=5.6 (index 6) to right beam at y=5.6 (index 0)
    y_anchor = (left_beams[6].position.y + right_beams[0].position.y) / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(left_beams[6], right_beams[0], (12.5, y_anchor), type='rigid')

    # Connect left beam at y=6.6 (index 7) to right beam at y=6.6 (index 1)
    y_anchor = (left_beams[7].position.y + right_beams[1].position.y) / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(left_beams[7], right_beams[1], (12.5, y_anchor), type='rigid')

    return left_beams[0]
